rules.law_name: Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance
rules.effective_date_basis: At its October 16, 2025 Special Meeting, the Rent Board approved relocation assistance payment increases that will go into effect on January 1, 2026.
rules.title: 2026 owner move-in eviction relocation assistance adjustment
rules.requirement: For an owner move-in eviction, the owner must pay relocation assistance to the tenant. Beginning January 1, 2026, the standard payment is $19,413, with an additional $6,471 for qualifying households.
rules.key_value: $19,413 standard; additional $6,471 for qualifying households; 1.5% CPI adjustment

coverage.other_unresolvable: Applies in the event of an owner move-in eviction; qualifying-household criteria are not stated in the document.
coverage.summary: Tenants evicted through an owner move-in eviction are covered, with an added payment for qualifying households.

rules.interaction: The document states that both the Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance and the Ellis Implementation Ordinance index relocation payments to inflation and require annual publication of increases.
rules.quoted_span: The Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance requires owners to pay tenants relocation assistance in the event of an owner move-in eviction.

rules.effective_date_basis: At its October 16, 2025 Special Meeting, the Rent Board approved relocation assistance payment increases that will go into effect on January 1, 2026.
rules.title: 2026 Ellis Act eviction relocation assistance adjustment
rules.requirement: For an Ellis Act eviction to remove a property from the rental housing market, the owner must pay the same relocation assistance amounts. Beginning January 1, 2026, the standard payment is $19,413, with an additional $6,471 for qualifying households.
rules.key_value: $19,413 standard; additional $6,471 for qualifying households; 1.5% CPI adjustment

coverage.other_unresolvable: Applies to tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market; qualifying-household criteria are not stated in the document.
coverage.summary: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act so an owner can remove a property from the rental housing market are covered, with an added payment for qualifying households.

rules.interaction: The document states that the Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same relocation assistance payments as the Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance and that both ordinances index the payments to inflation.
rules.quoted_span: The Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same relocation assistance payments for tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market.
